channel.description: Level up your Java code and explore what Spring can do for you.

item.title: A Bootiful Podcast: Java Developer Advocate Billy Korando on Java 27 and Beyond
item.dc:creator: joshlong
item.content:encoded: Hi Spring fans! In this installment, I am thrilled to have the chance to sit down with Java Developer Advocate Billy Korando to talk about the amazing features in the upcoming Java 27! We recorded this a day before I flew to San Francisco to attend the world premiere of the Java documentary, so as you can imagine, I've got goosebumps. To talk about what the language is bringing in the future and have this deep and amazing documentary experience about what the language has brought to developers and the world in 48 hours? Amazing. Thank you, Java, and thank you, Billy, for that amazing memory.

item.title: This Week in Spring - July 21st, 2026
item.dc:creator: joshlong
item.content:encoded:
Welcome to another installment of This Week in Spring! I'm writing this while enjoying a cup of coffee from the Caribbean on a little PTO. How're you doin'? Whenever I go on PTO, I like to sit by some body of water with a coffee and a laptop nearby. I alternate between plunges in the ocean and coding and sipping coffee. And learning. Learning is how you keep the ol' mind movin'. There's so much to get into from this last week, so let's dive right into it.

  • I did a roving tour of the basics of Spring, from beans to Boot, in this video here. Please check it out! If you want to understand what motivates Spring, what makes it tick: this video is for you!
  • An interesting Spring AI course for Udemy that I'd not seen before
  • Check out this amazing article on building AG-UI (Agentic UIs) with the Java SDK
  • Our friend at SivaLabs has a nice post on building chat with Spring AI](https://www.sivalabs.in/blog/spring-ai-chat-with-llms/)
  • Interesting (paywalled) article on how to use Spring AI (as opposed to making raw HTTP requests to the various models)
  • Interesting (Italian-language) discussion of how to do RAG with Spring AI
  • Of all the things, I just stumbled upon an interesting presentation on building with Spring AI and Embabel
  • I'm looking at this project I just discovered called Capstead, which aims to provide governance and (more granular) observability for your AI capabilities](https://github.com/satya-anguluri/capstead). It looks to sit on top of something like Spring AI (and Spring Boot). Interesting!
  • In last week's installment of A Bootiful Podcast, I had the privilege of sitting down with Spring ecosystem legend Russ Miles to talk about more productive AI interactions
  • I loved this latest post on Spring AI from Spring in Action author and legend Craig Walls, this one on persistent chat memory with Spring AI

item.title: This Week in Spring - July 14th, 2026
item.dc:creator: joshlong
item.content:encoded:
This Week in Spring - July 14th, 2026

In two short months, on this date in September, Java 27 will be here! Who's excited? I'm excited!

I'm in delightful Denver, CO, for the amazing UberConf. I just delivered a workshop that was scheduled from 09:00 to 17:00, but it went into overtime, and we just concluded at 18:30. Long day (story of my life)! Such a nice way to spend the day, though. Surrounded by cool people. As usual, though, the Spring ecosystem waits for no one. Let's dive right into this amazing week in Spring!

  • I did a video you might like, and I really hope you'll watch it, looking at what motivates Spring Framework and how we approach building things with it.
  • In last week's installment of A Bootiful Podcast, I talked to Spring Boot teammate Moritz Halbritter.
  • Loic Mathieu has a nice post on some of the amazing new features in Java 27
  • I can't believe I missed this: my friend and architecture extraordinairre Gregor Hohpe has an amazing interview on being an architect
  • Craig Walls is back with an amazing post on applying semantic guardrails
  • And another one by Craig Walls, this one on safeguarding LLM output
  • I love this: Spring AI AgentCore 2.0.0 is available
  • I loved this article on scaling Java-based real-time systems
  • InfoQ had a nice post way back in April on the concepts going beyond RAG in an AI application with Spring Boot
